concepts.description: The comment rule agents obey: source keeps only daggers, machine directives and a rare one-line why:, everything else goes to the margin; gloss is advisory, never delete to green; snippets/CLAUDE.gloss.md is its single source
Recognising comment forms in source: classifyComments into daggers/directives/why:/harvestable, built-in DIRECTIVE_PATTERNS, per-repo directive registration, JSX comment containers
The package.json `gloss` config (directives, whyMaxLength, exclude): loadRepoDirectives/setRepoDirectives, validation, config errors throw
Which source files every surface touches: .gitignore via git check-ignore (ignoredPaths), path-prefix excludes (isExcluded, setRepoExcludes), scoping path args, listSourceFiles/sourceFilesUnder
The one shared TypeScript-AST resolver binding a dagger to its declaration: parseSource, symbol keys, DAGGER/FILE_DAGGER/WHY_PREFIX constants and types
`gloss lint`: lintPaths/lintSource, comments that belong in the gloss, dagger-with-content errors, longWhy warnings and the why length limit
The .gloss/ mirror layout and markdown format: glossPathFor, h1/preamble/## <symbol> sections, parse/serialize/upsertSection, locating a sidecar and the gloss root
The write path: harvesting comments into sidecar sections and planting daggers, at commit (--staged) or on save (gloss watch, debounced), heading escaping
The bidirectional dagger<->section audit (checkRepo/checkFile) and its repair (fixRepo): renames, moved mirrors via git mv, orphans, never delete to green
`gloss read` / `gloss history`: rendering a gloss with staleness derived from git at read time, per-section history, shallow clones, rename hops
The git wrapper layer in src/git.ts: runGit, path/range commits and patches, rename-only detection, tracked and shallow checks
Harness-neutral agent context for Read/Grep: glossContextForRead/glossContextForGrep, identifier token from a grep pattern
The Claude Code adapter: PostToolUse hook I/O, silent failure and output cap, installed-bin hook command, .claude/settings.json merge
`gloss setup`: creating .gloss/, installing/diffing/updating the CLAUDE.md block from the snippet, offering hooks, lefthook wiring, publishing .gloss
The gloss bin dispatcher (src/cli.ts): command table, subcommand runners, hook-first dispatch, entry-path detection, repo root lookup, exit codes
Opt-in evals running real Claude Code sessions against the snippet: running them, cost, the four scenarios, re-run when the snippet changes (rollout gating)
